summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel 24.0.3 ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing bundled obfuscated payload
details: Version 24.0.3 of this ESLint sharable config adds a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte Bun-CJS bundle using string-array rotation obfuscation (rotator function, large mixed numeric/string constant array, custom-alphabet decoder) — its behavior is not statically inspectable. An ESLint sharable config has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or for executing an opaque bundled blob at install time. The package's `main` (`index.js`) is a real ESLint config matching the legitimate @ornikar/eslint-configs lineage, but the preinstall hook, `setup.mjs`, and `math_init.js` are additive files unrelated to ESLint, consistent with a compromised-maintainer or malicious-version publish. Installing this version runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's host with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
